edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.saved_converted_detail: The account, contact and deal are ready. Converting is handled on its own, so only custom fields from this save were applied; every other edit on this form was not. Reopen the lead and redo them.
edit.saved_detail: Changes to “{name}” are on the record.
edit.validation_heading: {count, plural, one {# field still needs you} other {# fields still need you}}
edit.hint_email_unique: One lead per address per org, ignoring case. The database enforces it, so a duplicate comes back as a rejected save rather than a second record.
edit.already_converted_title: This lead has already been converted
edit.already_converted_body1: Its account, contact and opportunity exist and carry the work now. The status stays where it is: reopening the lead would not remove any of them, and converting it again would build a second opportunity against the same account. The API refuses both.
edit.already_converted_body2: Everything else on this form is still editable. A converted lead is a record, not a read-only one.
edit.entering_converted_body1: An Account, a Contact and an Opportunity, with this lead's comments and attachments moved across. The lead stays as a converted record, and this is the last time you can change its status. There is no endpoint that undoes any of it.
edit.entering_converted_body2: Any other change on this form, aside from custom fields, is dropped when it saves alongside a conversion. Reopen the lead afterwards to redo it.
edit.hint_amount_placeholder: What the deal would be worth if it lands.
edit.error_last_name: A lead needs a name to be findable. First or last will do.
edit.error_email_required_convert: Converting creates a Contact, and a contact without an email cannot be reached.
edit.error_email_invalid: That does not look like an email address.
edit.error_email_taken: Another lead in this org already uses that address.
edit.error_phone_invalid: Digits and separators only. The API rejects letters, so "x123" extensions have to go in the notes.
edit.error_phone_too_long: Phone is stored in 25 characters; this is {length}.
edit.error_amount_not_number: Estimated value has to be a number.
